verification_notes: Audited from first principles: Operation of galvanometers, ammeters, and voltmeters verified. Shunt resistance formula S = (I_g * G) / (I - I_g) and series multiplier formula R_s = (V / I_g) - G derived from Kirchhoff's current and voltage laws. Boundary conditions R_A -> 0 (ideal ammeter) and R_V -> infinity (ideal voltmeter) rigorously validated for zero circuit perturbation. Dimensional homogeneity confirmed: [S] = Ohms, [R_s] = Ohms, [R_A] = Ohms, [R_V] = Ohms. Limiting cases verified: I -> I_g implies S -> infinity; I -> infinity implies S -> 0; V -> I_g*G implies R_s -> 0; V -> infinity implies R_s -> infinity. Claim traces to curriculum node and formula-curr-measuring-meters verified.
